• It was the first plan to be prepared after the dismantling of the Soviet Union, which had a significant impact on India's economic policies.
 
• The plan emphasized on **enhancing productivity, improving quality of products, and increasing competitiveness** in the global market.

questions.question: In a capitalist society the goods produced are distributed among people ______.

options.text: only on the basis of what people need
on the basis of what people need and on the basis of Purchasing Power
not on the basis of Purchasing Power
not on the basis of what people need but on the basis of Purchasing Power

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**not on the basis of what people need but on the basis of Purchasing Power**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In a capitalist society, goods are distributed **not on the basis of what people need but on the basis of Purchasing Power**.
 
• Purchasing Power refers to the financial ability of individuals to buy goods and services.
 
• This system often leads to inequalities where those with higher purchasing power can afford more goods and services, while those with less purchasing power may struggle to meet their basic needs.
 
• The principle of distribution based on purchasing power is fundamental to the functioning of a capitalist economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Capitalism is an economic system where private individuals or businesses own capital goods.
 
• The production of goods and services is based on supply and demand in the general market (market economy), rather than through central planning (planned economy or command economy).
 
• In capitalist economies, the prices of goods and services are determined in a free price system set by supply and demand.
 
• Key characteristics of capitalism include private property, capital accumulation, wage labor, voluntary exchange, a price system, and competitive markets.
 
• Critics of capitalism argue that it can lead to economic inequality, exploitation, and social injustice.

questions.question: _______ is a state or condition in which an individual or community lacks the financial resources and essentials for a minimum standard of living.

• **Poverty** is a state or condition in which an individual or community lacks the financial resources and essentials for a minimum standard of living.
 
• It is a multifaceted concept, which includes social, economic, and political elements.
 
• Poverty can be measured in terms of income level, but it also encompasses a lack of access to basic needs such as food, shelter, education, and healthcare.
 
• Addressing poverty often requires a combination of economic growth, social policies, and targeted interventions to support vulnerable populations.

• The United Nations has set specific goals to reduce poverty through initiatives like the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly Goal 1: No Poverty.
 
• Various factors such as unemployment, lack of education, and social exclusion contribute to the perpetuation of poverty.
 
• Effective poverty alleviation strategies often involve improving access to education, healthcare, and employment opportunities.

• M.S.Swaminathan is known as the father of the Green Revolution in India.
 
• The 'Evergreen Revolution' aims to make agriculture sustainable and increase productivity without harming the environment.
 
• It focuses on the use of eco-friendly technology and practices to ensure food security for future generations.

Simple Interest (SI) = Principal × Rate × Time / 100

Compound Interest (CI) for half-yearly compounding = Principal × (1 + Rate/2/100)²×Time - Principal

Difference = CI - SI

**Calculation:**

Let the principal be P.

Rate = 30% per annum

Time = 1 year

Simple Interest (SI) = P × 30 × 1 / 100

SI = 0.3P

Half-yearly rate = 30/2 = 15%

Compound Interest (CI) = P × (1 + 15/100)² - P

CI = P × (1 + 0.15)² - P

CI = P × (1.15)² - P

CI = P × 1.3225 - P

CI = 1.3225P - P

CI = 0.3225P

Difference = CI - SI

0.3225P - 0.3P = 337.5

⇒ 0.0225P = 337.5

⇒ P = 337.5 / 0.0225

⇒ P = 15000

**The sum is Rs. 15000.**
